akh.text: Naktamun is the city of Amonkhet where initiates train for the trials, and the Gatewatch arrives to find that beneath its order something is wrong, as a woman runs through the street shouting that the trials, gods and hours are lies and soldiers capture her.

Gideon meets the god Oketra, who calls him by his birth name Kytheon Iora, and he later decides to compete in the Trials as her Champion, wanting to prove himself to gods he believes are good at their core.

Nissa reads carved glyphs in an old alley and concludes that Nicol Bolas did not create Amonkhet but corrupted it, while Samut denounces the God-Pharaoh, is labeled a dissenter and is imprisoned in a sarcophagus until the Gatewatch frees her.
When the Hour of Revelation comes, the dragon fractures Kefnet's mind, bursts through the Hekma, and dissipates every mortal old enough to walk.

hou.text: Naktamun is ruined in the Hour of Devastation, when three gods of destruction shatter the Hekma and slay most of the other gods while mummies and Eternals attack the city.
Elementals rise to turn on the city, the wandering dead pour in through the broken Hekma, and Samut urges Djeru to lead people out while aven guide the last of them away from the ruins.
Hazoret survives as the only living god and fights the Scorpion God, and the living bring it down by driving it onto an obelisk.
After Bolas's Eternals leave, Hazoret and the survivors reclaim Naktamun, raise the Hekma and begin rebuilding, and the Luxa begins to run clear.
